title: Grateful Dead Live at Universal Amphitheatre on 1973-07-01

ai_review.summary: A pristine '73 Miller soundboard captures an electrifying show highlighted by a monster Playing in the Band, unstoppable Big River and sublime China‑Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider.
ai_review.review: The recording is a clean, well‑balanced soundboard mix that showcases the band's tight playing – especially Jerry’s fiery solo on Big River and the soaring transitions from China Cat Sunflower into Rider. Reviewers rave about standout moments like Playing in the Band, The Other One, and an early Loose Lucy delivered at a relaxed tempo, while the overall set flows just right without feeling rushed or dragging.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings and enthusiastic comments on both performance and audio quality indicate an excellent show with superb soundboard recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Multiple reviewers note a clean, crisp Miller board mix and great transfer; no significant flaws reported.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: Set pacing is praised as just right – not too fast nor too slow – with smooth transitions and high energy peaks.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His solo on Big River is described as unstoppable and jam‑filled.
